name: radial-wedge-gallery
title: Radial Wedge Gallery
description: A disc cut into pie slices, one photo per slice, with numbered badges. Hovering/choosing a slice widens it while the others shrink, and the disc rotates it to the top; the round hub shows its number, title and discipline. Double-click, Enter or the hub opens the photo full-frame with a circular iris reveal.
darkMode: fully shadcn tokens (card, background, foreground, muted, border, ring, chart-2) - follows the theme
mainProps: items: {src, title, alt?, id?, year?, discipline?}[], active/defaultActive/onActiveChange (null = even overview), expanded/onExpandedChange, autoplay, interval, hubTitle, plus any <div> props
notes: Square by default (aspect-ratio 1/1) - set a width, or pass style={{aspectRatio:'auto'}} + a height to fill a box. React 19 (ref as prop, inert). 6-10 items look best. Hover selects with a mouse, so it reacts as soon as the cursor crosses it.
